request.subject: CURIOSITY:GOLD_CLAIM

layers.text: Style: bold chibi pixel art for a playful turn-based strategy board game, a board game come to life: chunky simple shapes, flat colours with one shadow tone, low detail, clean readable silhouette that reads at a glance at small size, slightly silly and cheerful.
layers.negative: photorealism, painterly brushwork, gradients, dithering, noise, tiny details, thin outline, low-poly 3D, faceted polygons, blur, text, letters, numbers, logo, UI, frame, health bar, selection ring, cropped subject

layers.text: Camera: consistent strategy-game camera, three-quarter view looking slightly down, the subject faces down and to the right (south-east), whole subject visible and centred on a transparent background, nothing cropped. The subject stands directly on the empty transparent background: nothing at all is drawn under it.

Class: one small ancient map landmark that belongs to no faction, a single compact feature with a simple clear silhouette that reads at a glance, calmer and less saturated than a unit, thick single-colour black outline, big simple shapes and flat colours with one shadow tone. It stands directly on the empty transparent background with nothing drawn under it: no ground, no grass, no soil, no water, no slab and no platform. Materials: weathered pale grey stone, bone white, old grey-brown driftwood and a little dull moss. No flag, no banner, no heraldry and nothing painted in a team colour.

layers.text: Subject: a small old gold mine claim: the dark mouth of a mine tunnel framed by three thick weathered grey-brown timber beams, set into the side of one big rounded pale grey boulder, one wooden stake with a frayed rope driven in beside it, and a small tipped wooden ore cart in front spilling a heap of shiny gold nuggets; weathered grey-brown wood and pale grey stone, the nuggets warm gold with a darker amber shadow tone; no flag; the claim is the only thing in the image.

The claim is big and wide: the boulder and the ore cart together touch the left edge and the right edge of the image. The boulder is weathered mid grey stone with a darker grey shadow tone, not white. The stake is a tall thin wooden post with a frayed rope tied round it. Nothing is drawn under it: no grass, no soil and no ground block.
layers.negative: grass, ground block, dirt block, soil, island, platform, white boulder, snow, flag, person
